name: pokemon-locations-region-multiplex
description: Multiplex encounter hypergraph with PokéAPI Pokémon entries as nodes and regions as layers. In each layer, a hyperedge corresponds to one location area in that region and contains the Pokémon encounterable there across available game versions and encounter methods.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., pokemon-locations-region-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).
hypergraph_metadata.layer_type: (STRING) Semantic type of multiplex layers (e.g., region).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Pokémon name (e.g., pikachu).
nodes_metadata.generation: (STRING) Generation where the Pokémon species was introduced (e.g., generation-i).
nodes_metadata.is_default: (BOOL) Whether this is the default Pokémon form (e.g., true).
nodes_metadata.secondary_type: (STRING) Secondary Pokémon type when present (e.g., flying).

edges_metadata.location_area_ids: (list of INTs) PokéAPI location-area identifiers represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [285]).
edges_metadata.area_names: (list of STRINGs) Location area names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pallet-town-area]).
edges_metadata.location_names: (list of STRINGs) Parent location names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pallet-town]).
edges_metadata.regions: (list of STRINGs) Regions represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [kanto]).
edges_metadata.versions: (list of STRINGs) Game versions in which the incidence appears (e.g., [red]).
edges_metadata.encounter_methods: (list of STRINGs) Encounter methods represented by the incidence (e.g., [walk]).
edges_metadata.n_observations: (INT) Number of raw PokéAPI encounter observations aggregated into the hyperedge (e.g., 12).

license_note: Data derived from PokéAPI. Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo. PokéAPI is not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, or Creatures.
